vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: adhd-founder-planner
Version: 1.1.1

The skill bundle is benign. The `scripts/plan.sh` script operates entirely within its designated skill directory (`~/.openclaw/skills/adhd-daily-planner/`), creating and modifying markdown files for planning purposes. It does not attempt to access sensitive system files, make network requests, or execute arbitrary commands from user input (user input for `sed` is properly escaped). The `SKILL.md` and `README.md` files contain no instructions that could be interpreted as prompt injection against an AI agent, and external links point transparently to the stated author's website (adhd-founder.com).
